column1: # the per-skill computeOutput formulas the client vendors from slice 6a:
# WillOfLife, whose output its skill description shows, and the party
# bonus lookups, partyEffectBoost and partyDurationBoost, read at and past
# both ends of their tables, directly and through Bless. Every row is
# asserted for exact equality by the server's formula_tests and by the
# client's decore_tests on every client toolchain. A changed expected
# value is a balance change: review it as one. UPDATE_GOLDENS=1
# formula_tests rewrites the expected column only.
# The server's WillOfLife handler takes Damage as both the HP it charges
# (before the Wisdom of Blood rank bonus and the consume-MP ratio of the
# vampire's gear, which are not here) and the effect's bonus, Duration as
# the effect's duration and Delay as the time until the skill can be used
# again. The client's description (VS_UI_Description.cpp) shows Damage as
# the Will of Life's HP cost in place of its own 5 + level / 7, which gives
# Tab-separated, one row per call: function, row name, the inputs, and the
# WillOfLife and Bless columns: the ten SkillInput fields in declaration
#   order (SkillLevel DomainLevel DomainGrade STR DEX INTE TargetType Range
#   Gun PartySize), then expected: the six SkillOutput fields,
#   comma-separated in declaration order (Damage, Duration, Tick, ToHit,
#   Range, Delay), computed from a zeroed SkillOutput. Gun is written by
#   its GunClass enumerator name (SG, AR, SMG, SR, Other); TargetType 0 is
#   TARGET_SELF, 1 TARGET_OTHER, 2 TARGET_MAX. The server fills the input
#   from the caster (skill/SkillHandler.cpp): for a vampire, SkillLevel is
#   its level (VAMPIRE_MAX_LEVEL is 150), STR, DEX and INTE its current
#   stats, Range its advancement class level, DomainLevel 0, TargetType 2,
#   Gun Other and PartySize 0; DomainGrade is -1 unless one of the three
#   grade formulas needs it. PartySize is 0 for a vampire or a monster and
#   1 for a slayer or an ousters, never the size of a party, so on the
#   server no party bonus is granted (docs/FIXES.md); a client caller must
# partyEffectBoost and partyDurationBoost columns: partySize expected (the
#   percent). The tables cover sizes 0 to 6; a size below 0 reads the 0
#   entry and one above 6 the 6 entry.
# WillOfLife reads SkillLevel only: 5 + SkillLevel / 7, 30 + SkillLevel,
# and twice that, with the division truncating toward zero (-1 gives 5,
# -8 gives 4). The level-largest and level-smallest rows are the last
# levels whose Delay fits an int; past them the formula overflows, which
# is undefined, so no row goes there. The wol-grid-* rows are every level
# 0 to 28 and 30 to 150 by 10, with the input a vampire caster gives. The
# bless-grid-* rows are party sizes -1 to 7 for a self and an other target
# at level 40 with INT 80 and level 100 with INT 200.
